The petitioner was neither entitled to receive nor use nor annex these recommendations nor does it disclose any cause of action for the instant Writ petition. According to the Learned Assistant Attorney General, the Utilization -Declaration are given by the importer before import statin; specifications and purpose of import and no presumption could be drawn about export from those Utilization Declarations and the audit in question was conducted before rill period during which this alleged fraud an forgery was committed. The learned Assistant-Attorney-Genera has relied upon the cases of Chairman National Board of Revenue Vs. Nasrin Bann and 5 others, reported in 48 DLR (AD) 171 Bangladesh Vs. Md. Abdul Jaill and other reported in 48-D1,R (AD) II, Al-Haj Abu Basher Vs. Bangladesh and others, reported it 50 (DLR(AD) 11 and the case of Shawr Apparels Ltd. Vs. Commissioner of Custom: and others reported in 52 DLR 316 . In reply thereto Mr. Md. Aman Ullah, the Learned Advocate for the petitioner has placed his reliance upon the cases of B Gajapathi Rao Vs. State of Andra Pradesh AIR 1964 (SC) 1645, Polurrian Steamshir Company Ltd.Vs. Young, I KBD 922, Miar Jamal Shah Vs. Member Election Commission, 18 DLR (SC) 1, State Vs.. Zahh & others, 45 DLR (AD) 163, Province of East Pakistan Vs. Abdus Sobhan Sowdagar, DLR (SC) 38 etc, They are all illuminating. 

 In her Utilization Declaration she undertook to produce these documents to the Customs Officials. She is therefore bound by law and Licence. This Court shall not make any presumption on disputed annexures or facts.
